keyEvents.text: Boris Kouassi (Deportiva Minera) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Mohamed Kamal (CD Minera) Substitution at 45'
Goal! Deportiva Minera 0, Cartagena 1. Marcelo dos Santos (Cartagena) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Marc Jurado.
Rubén Serrano (Cartagena) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Aimar Olarra (CD Minera) Substitution at 63'
Goal! Deportiva Minera 1, Cartagena 1. Boris Kouassi (Deportiva Minera) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Aaron Piñan.
Daniel Perejón (FC Cartagena) Substitution at 70'
Álex Gutiérrez (FC Cartagena) Substitution at 71'
Maikel Villajos (CD Minera) Substitution at 73'
Miguel Serrano Mateos (CD Minera) Substitution at 73'
Ibán (FC Cartagena) Substitution at 81'
Second yellow card to Boris Kouassi (Deportiva Minera) for a bad foul.
Carlos Ramírez (CD Minera) Substitution at 89'
Raúl Dacosta (FC Cartagena) Substitution at 90'
Lázaro Rubio (CD Minera) Substitution at 102'
Miguel Serrano Mateos (Deportiva Minera) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Marcos Moreno (FC Cartagena) Substitution at 105'
Pablo de Blasis (FC Cartagena) Substitution at 105'
Imanol Baz (Cartagena) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ángel Cano (Deportiva Minera) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Deportiva Minera 1, Cartagena 2. Raúl Dacosta (Cartagena) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ibán Ribeiro.
Mohamed Kamal (Deportiva Minera) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
